scope: Six full saved PC journeys: natural voice fetch, camera question, Stop, Proceed, completion-aware Proceed and return through browser capture, CUDA speech-edge ASR, local models, task bus and native camera physics; no microphone or speakers

source_text.fetch: Could you bring me something for turning screws, please?
source_text.question: What do you see?

timing_reference: Browser source-start plus last clean 40 ms frame RMS >= 0.008; native stop_requested matched by unique job is bounded between browser Stop POST and acknowledgment minus independently logged time spent cleaning the queue AFTER native acknowledgment, rounded down to whole ms. Require this conservative upper bound <=1000 ms; do not compare unsynchronized browser/WSL wall clocks.
